review_conclusions.reason: Source remains intentionally nonconforming to PDF/A-4 because Type6 is forbidden there, so screening loss is authorized. Erratum314 removes the separate transfer-function prohibition only. The independently derived pixel and controls identify the additional transfer mapping loss; the verdict does not rely on Part4 accepting Type6.

The three event-placement controls discriminate visibility from current-page open/close and the seam is explicitly a supplied runner. Source semantics and callback-level claim align; execution evidence matches identities.

In each override fixture the sole K content object is page 2 while parent /Pg is page 1. Scratch copies add a real parent-page sibling content item and corresponding ParentTree association; these are drafts only.

Literal color/geometry assertions are independent of renderer-to-renderer agreement; baseline and isolated BBox/caller clip boundaries are discriminating. No fixture validity defect identified in this review.

The test checks actual collection query and public row consumer with literal labels and extraction keys under valid reciprocal Parent/Child/Next links. It does not invent a reader-side reciprocal-link rejection duty.
